description: a ball of radius R revolved about the axis of a solid cylinder of the same radius, cut from it: the sphere touches the wall along its equator, a circle interior to both faces, and both survive a cut — the wall outside the ball, the sphere inside the cylinder — so the result would carry two faces sharing a circle with no material between them. pin-in-bore-cut's refusal along a closed contact curve, whose blocks wrap as a section loop's do: both seams pass through the one point (R, 0, H / 2), so the circle is paved once. Open CASCADE builds it; Arris refuses with OpError::Degenerate and Reason::TangentContact naming the pair, decided by the curvature rule (plans/c3-conic-hits step 7)
